{{Quote|Ask me of my heritage, and I shall tell you. Ask me of my ambitions, and you shall know them. Ask me for my hand in battle, and I shall likely lend you both. But ask me the secrets of Sith alchemy, and I would ask you for three measures of blood: one from a person you love, one from a person you hate, and one from yourself.|Naga Sadow's words, as recorded in his holocron|<ref name="JvS" />}}
The '''Holocron of Naga Sadow''',<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> also known as '''Sadow's Holocron''', was the [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]<ref name="Companion" /> to record his knowledge of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]<ref name="JvS" /> sometime to the collapse of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] was recovered from a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] library by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and from it the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] learned much of the history of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and their relation to the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] from the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]].<ref name="Companion" /> Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, the Sith Lord [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] acquired the holocron, and incorporated Sadow's teachings into his own writings, ''[[The Creation of Monsters]]'', and also included a recording of the holocron's contents in the [[Telos Holocron]]. In order to access the holocron's alchemical knowledge, Sadow's [[Gatekeeper/Legends|Gatekeeper]] demanded that users perform a blood ritual of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] that he claimed would [[Death/Legends|kill]] the unworthy.<ref name="JvS" />
